{"consolidated_memory":"SERIES: Silent drops in notifications/push/dispatch.py dispatcher (5 separate occasions, 2026-01-11 to 2026-05-12)

All incidents involved the same core symptom (sends reporting success with no delivery despite rotated device tokens triggering the dispatch), same file (notifications/push/dispatch.py), and same reproduction pattern (dispatch to a device token that was rotated). Each required a distinct fix addressing a different root cause.

OCCASION 1: [2026-01-11] — Silent drop via unknown field serialization
- Trigger: traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- Root cause: serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Fix: switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #1398 on branch fix/silent-drop-1
- Measured outcome: flaky test reduced from 97 failures per hundred runs to zero

OCCASION 2: [2026-01-19] — Silent drop via unbounded retry loop
- Trigger: manifested only after client had already retried once
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #4468 on branch fix/silent-drop-2
- Measured outcome: cold start latency dropped 2 percent, reaching 240 ms

OCCASION 3: [2026-01-29] — Silent drop via bare except swallowing errors
- Trigger: affected clients still pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: error swallowed by bare except
- Fix: narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #4977 on branch fix/silent-drop-3
- Measured outcome: nightly rollup matched source counts for 51 days running

OCCASION 4: [2026-04-30] — Silent drop due to clock skew at large payload sizes
- Trigger: payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: clock skew between two hosts
- Fix: switched deadline to monotonic clock
- PR #5961 on branch fix/silent-drop-4
- Measured outcome: job execution improved from 8 hours to 10 minutes

OCCASION 5: [2026-05-12] — Silent drop from schema drift in deeply nested inputs
- Trigger: deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: schema drift between migration and model
- Fix: regenerated model from migration and pinned checksum
- PR #7300 on branch fix/silent-drop-6
- Measured outcome: eliminated 44 duplicate rows written per day

All fixes applied to the same corner of notifications/push/dispatch.py; context carried across incidents."}
